description.en: Iron Allomancy allows you to see blue lines extending from your center of mass to that of nearby metal objects.
While you Brace using an object/structure larger than you, use its size instead of your own for the effects of Ironpulling and Steelpushing.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

Ironpull an object toward a character and make a ranged Allomancy attack vs. Physical.

**Prerequisite** Athletics 2+ or Heavy Weaponry 2+.

Make Lurching Crash attacks using a melee weapon or unarmed attack.
Before an ally is attacked with a metal projectile, spend 1 Investiture to make yourself the target.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

Use Projectile Lurch on metal weapons. Test Allomancy vs. the attack roll to become the target and pull the weapon from the attacker's hand.

**Prerequisite** Expertise in a Defensive weapon or an armor with deflect 3+.

While burning iron and wielding or wearing the item in this talent's prerequiste, increase your deflect and ignore Pierce.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

Spend 1 focus to use Ironpull additional times. Additionally, gain reaction each turn for Projectile Lurch.
Atium Allomancy causes you to see **atium shadows** of all the people and objects in sight, projecting the many immediate futures possible for those people and objects.
Your Burn Atium d20 value increases by your ranks in Allomancy for your tests, and decreases by the same for enemy tests.

**Prerequisite** Insight 3+.

While burning atium, you can also affect tests that mentally or spiritually interact with a character.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 4+.

While burning atium, set each damage die you roll to its maximum value.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 5+.

After an enemy finishes a turn while you're burning atium, **spend 1 focus** to use action or reaction.

**Prerequisite** Deception 3+.

While burning atium, avoid being grazed or triggering enemy reactions.

**Prerequisite** Discipline 4+.

Before an effect sets your dice to a static value, **spend 1 focus** to ignore the effect.
Bendalloy Allomancy forms a time bubble around you, within which time passes more quickly than outside the bubble.
Spend an additional 1 Investiture to increase a time bubble's area to 25 feet.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

When you fail an endeavor's skill test while in a bendalloy bubble, spend 1 focus to gain Complication instead.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

Before a character acts in a way that could be affected by a time bubble, spend 1 focus to Burn Bendalloy or Burn Cadmium.
While in a bendalloy bubble, your defenses against outside effects increase by the Investiture spent to create that bubble.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

It costs you one fewer action to Burn Bendalloy or Burn Cadmium.
Brass Allomancy subtly dampens the emotions of people nearby, encouraging them to act against those emotions while believing it's their idea.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

When you burn brass or zinc, increase the size of the area, up to Colossal (30-foot).

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

It costs you one fewer to burn brass or zinc, and you can choose for some targets to be unaffected by those powers.

**Prerequisite** Insight 3+.

**Spend 1 Investiture** to gain an advantage when influencing others. Minions and Rivals who resist lose an additional 2 focus.
While Soothing a character who has 0 focus, spend 2 Investiture to also make them Stunned.

**Prerequisite** Insight 2+.

Burn brass to instead cause targets to recover health and temporarily reduce their Exhausted penalty.

**Prerequisite** Insight 3+.

When you Soothe Fatigue, also end effects equal to the Investiture spent. Choose from Disoriented, Stunned, Surprised, and effects that increase focus costs.
Bronze Allomancy causes you to sense rhythmic drumlike pulses from nearby kinetic Investiture.
Your Metallic Art range doubles for your Bronze Allomancy power.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

Burn bronze without spending Investiture. When an enemy benefits from an Invested ability, remove the Surprised condition from yourself.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

When Seeking an effect, you identify its power. Test Allomancy as action to also learn the power's effects and targets.
While Seeking an effect, you can sense its source's maximum and current Investiture.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

When you detect an enemy's Invested effect, their next test against you gains a disadvantage, or you gain an advantage on the next test they force you to make.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

Detect nearly any Invested ability, including Feruchemical powers and other abilities that don't spend Investiture.
Cadmium Allomancy forms a time bubble around you, within which time passes more slowly than outside the bubble.
Spend an additional 1 Investiture to increase a time bubble's area to 25 feet.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

Burn bronze without spending Investiture. When an enemy benefits from an Invested ability, remove the Surprised condition from yourself.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

Before a character acts in a way that could be affected by a time bubble, spend 1 focus to Burn Bendalloy or Burn Cadmium.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

It costs you one fewer action to Burn Bendalloy or Burn Cadmium.
Chromium Allomancy allows you to touch Metalborn or other characters who have Invested abilities, instantly depleting their reserve of power and leaving only a sudden coldness.
After you succeed on a physical test against a target within reach, spend Opportunity or 2 focus to Burn Chromium against them, automatically succeeding on your Allomancy test.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

You can Leech two targets at the same time, raising the stakes on your Allomancy test if both are unwilling.
Spend additional Investiture when you Burn Chromium, up to your Metallic Art limit, to roll that many additional dice.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 4+.

Leech metalmind charges equal to your Metallic Art die (instead of half that many), and Leech a metalmind even if its wearer has Investiture.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

Before a character uses an Invested ability, Burn Chromium to potentially deplete them of needed resources.

**Prerequisite** Thievery 2+.

Gain reaction for Dodge or your Reactive Leech talent. After you Dodge an attacker, spend 1 focus to target them with Burn Chromium.
Copper Allomancy creates an invisible cloud around you that prevents others from detecting Investiture used by anyone inside your coppercloud.
Before a character uses an Invested ability that can be blocked by a coppercloud, spend 1 focus to Burn Copper.

**Prerequisite** Stealth 3+.

Before an ally within your coppercloud makes a Stealth test or a test with raised stakes, spend 1 focus to grant them an advantage.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

Your Burn Copper duration doubles, and you can change the size of your coppercloud as free action.
The maximum radius of your coppercloud increases by 5 × your ranks in Allomancy.
When burned while using another power, Duralumin Allomancy flares through your entire Investiture reserve in an instantaneous burst.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 4+; at least one other power or Invested ability.

When you Burn Duralumin, you gain more control and don't have to roll a plot die.

**Prerequisite** at least two other powers or Invested abilities.

When you Burn Duralumin, you can become Depleted of the burst power instead of spending Investiture.
Gold Allomancy causes you to see shadowy projections of yourself.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

Forgo a long rest and spend 1 Investiture to roll a plot die. On Opportunity, advance a goal. On Complication, become Exhausted [−1].

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 4+.

Plot die blanks for Burn Gold and Alloy of Self count as Opportunity. Additionally, Burn Gold's Focused condition lasts longer.
Electrum Allomancy causes you to see **electrum shadows** projecting from you, representing many immediate futures possible for you.
Spend an electrum shadow instead of reaction to use Dodge or Reactive Strike.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

You can reroll the d20 for one shadow. Additionally, burning electrum ends the Surprised condition on yourself.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

While burning electrum, attacks can't graze you and Reactive Strikes gain a disadvantage.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

Spend additional Investiture when you maintain Burn Electrum to keep that many shadows for an additional round.

**Prerequisite** Insight 2+.

When you test against a character, spend a shadow to replace your d20 roll with the shadow's recorded result.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

Once per round, after you use an action or reaction, spend 3 Investiture to undo it.
Nicrosil Allomancy allows you to touch a Metalborn who's using an Invested ability, causing their entire reserve of power to instantly and explosively expend itself.
Spend Investiture to burst that many Invested abilities of an character in reach. If they're unwilling, test Physical.

**Prerequisite** Athletics 2+ or Thievery 2+.

After a physical test vs. a character within reach, spend Opportunity or 2 focus to target them with Proactive Nicroburst.

**Prerequisite** Stealth 3+.

When you burst an enemy's ability, add a disadvantage to their plot die, and influence how is resolved.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 4+.

When you Burn Nicrosil to assist an ally, they gain more control and don't have to roll a plot die.
Pewter Allomancy significantly increases your physical capabilities and your constitution.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 2+.

**Spend 1 Investiture** to recover health equal to 1d6 + your tier, even if you're Unconscious.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

When reduced to 0 health while burning pewter, ignore Unconscious but become Exhausted [−1] each time you take damage.

**Prerequisite** Heavy Weaponry 1+ or Light Weaponry 1+.

While burning pewter or tapping strength, replace your melee weapon's damage with your unarmed damage dice.

**Prerequisite** Agility 1+.

While burning pewter, use Speed for unarmed attacks, Grapple, and Shove.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

While burning pewter, become Exhausted [−1] to make an additional Strike with the same hand.
While burning pewter or tapping strength, weapons gain Thrown [100/300]. When they're thrown, you can use your unarmed damage dice.
